description: The user's FileSeen links, newest first, with opens, unique viewers, reading time and completion, both all time and within the `since` window. Use it for 'how are my links doing', 'which documents were opened today' (since=today, opened=true) or 'which were never opened' (since=all, opened=false). Totals come first. Reading this never counts as an open.

limit.description: Rows to return (default 25). Totals always cover every match.

opened.description: true: only links opened within the window; false: only links NOT opened within it.

query.description: Only links whose file name, link id or label contains this text.

since.description: Time window: 24h, 7d, 30d, 4w, today, yesterday, all, or an ISO date/datetime such as 2026-10-01 (UTC unless an offset is given). Default 30d.

name: list_my_links
title: List my FileSeen links
